title: חסד קטן
theme: a small kindness to a stranger
emotional_truth: a tiny kindness, given freely, changes two people — the receiver and you

forbidden: forcing help on someone who said no
touching or approaching in a way that ignores discomfort
any act that endangers self or others
safety.notes: Kindness is never intrusive. A stranger's 'no' is always respected — retreating warmly is its own kind of kindness. Success is the offering, never how it was received.
